blocks.text: American TV personality and businesswoman Kim Kardashian recently visited the Philippines and enjoyed its white-sand beaches to celebrate her birthday. Kardashian documented her trip through her Instagram page on Friday, Oct. 16, writing in the caption “Philippines Birthday Adventures.” During her visit, she soaked up the sun on an undisclosed island, went scuba diving, and had a candle-lit dinner by the beach accompanied by a fireworks display. Kardashian also received a warm welcome from Filipino celebrities including Anne Curtis, KC Concepcion, Janine Gutierrez and Isabelle Daza who shared greetings via the comments section.
